rows.label: Impuesto inmobiliario (property tax): municipal, on the cadastral fiscal valuation
rows.value: The impuesto inmobiliario is collected by the municipalities on the fiscal valuation of each property, set by the municipality under the annual rules of the National Cadastre Service; 70% stays with the municipality, 15% goes to the department and 15% to the municipalities with the fewest resources (Asunción keeps 85%).

rows.label: Municipal tax on the transfer of real estate
rows.value: Municipalities levy a tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate (impuesto a la transferencia de dominio de bienes raíces), among the municipal taxes listed in Law 3966.

rows.value: Municipalities levy the vehicle licence tax (patente de rodados) among the municipal taxes listed in Law 3966.
